parameters.help_en: The application IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 应用id列表。输入多个时，以英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: app_ids

Code.description_en:
The API status or POP error code. Value description:

2xx: The request was successful. 3xx: The request was redirected. 4xx: The request was invalid. 5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

ChangeOrderId.description_en: The ID of the change process

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code. Value description:

If the request succeeds, this field is not returned. It is returned only if the request fails. For more information, see the "Error codes" section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The additional information. Value description:

If the request succeeds, a success message is returned. If the request fails, an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the applications were started. Valid values:

true and false
Success.description_zh:
批量启动应用是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：表示批量启动应用成功。
false：表示批量启动应用失败

TraceId.description_en: The ID of the trace, which is used to query the exact call information
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
